title.narrative: Supporting Agreements for Peace and a Resumption of the Political Process in Yemen

description.narrative:
UNOPS supports the UN Special Envoy’s efforts to provide support to the Yemen peace process, and the implementation of any eventual agreements to enable the resumption of a peaceful, inclusive, orderly and Yemeni-led transition.

UNOPS activities support the operational and logistical requirements to conduct negotiations aimed at reaching a negotiated political settlement aimed at ending the conflict; and provide technical advice to mediation teams and the conflict parties to strengthen negotiation capacities and assist in development of conflict-ending proposals. 

The intended results of this project are the resumption of peace and political negotiations in Yemen; the development of credible proposals addressing major points of contention in the conflict; and the support for a political settlement, a resumption of an inclusive national dialogue, and a sustained and peaceful political transition.
